units.literal: In Yongyuan, Xiao Yaoguang and Cui Huijing rebelled; he repeatedly had battle merit and through merit rose to front general.

units.zh: 天監四年，王師北討，仙琕每戰，勇冠三軍，當其沖者，莫不摧破。
units.en: In Tianjian year four, the royal army marched north; Xianpin in every battle was bravest in the three armies; whoever met his charge was shattered.
units.literal: In Tianjian year four, the royal army marched north; Xianpin in every battle was bravest in the three armies; whoever met his charge was not left unbroken.

units.zh: 起家郢州主簿，遷武騎常侍，爲小將，隨齊安陸王蕭緬。
units.en: He began as Yezhou chief clerk, rose to martial-cavalry regular attendant, served as a junior officer, and followed Qi's prince of Anlu Xiao Mian.
units.literal: He began office as Yezhou chief clerk, transferred to martial-cavalry regular attendant, served as a junior officer, and followed Qi Prince of Anlu Xiao Mian.

units.zh: 復以功遷寧朔將軍、豫州刺史。
units.en: Again through merit he was transferred to pacifying-the-north general and Yuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Again through merit he was transferred to pacifying-the-north general and Yuzhou inspector.

units.zh: 出爲龍驤將軍、南汝陰、譙二郡太守。
units.en: He went out as dragon-prancing general and prefect of Nan Ruyin and Qiao.
units.literal: He went out as dragon-prancing general and prefect of Nan Ruyin and Qiao.

units.zh: 授輔國將軍、宋安、安蠻二郡太守，遷南義陽太守。
units.en: He was appointed supporting-the-state general and prefect of Song'an and Anman, then south Yiyang prefect.
units.literal: He was appointed supporting-the-state general and prefect of Song'an and Anman, transferred to south Yiyang prefect.

units.zh: 義師起，四方多回應，高祖使仙琕故人姚仲賓說之，仙琕於軍斬仲賓以徇。
units.en: When the Righteous Army rose, all quarters largely responded; Gaozu sent Xianpin's old friend Yao Zhongbin to win him over; Xianpin beheaded Zhongbin in camp to warn the host.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army rose, all quarters largely responded; Gaozu sent Xianpin's old friend Yao Zhongbin to persuade him; Xianpin in the army beheaded Zhongbin to display to the host.

units.zh: 十年，朐山民殺琅邪太守劉晣，以城降魏，詔假仙琕節，討之。
units.en: In year ten the people of Qushan killed Langye prefect Liu Xi and surrendered the city to Wei; an edict granted Xianpin credentials to attack.
units.literal: In year ten, the people of Qushan killed Langye prefect Liu Xi and offered the city in surrender to Wei; an edict granted Xianpin credentials to attack.

units.zh: 十一年，遷持節、督豫北豫霍三州諸軍事、信武將軍、豫州刺史，領南汝陰太守。
units.en: In year eleven he was transferred bearer of staff, commander of Yu, north Yu, and Huo, faithful martial general and Yuzhou inspector, with concurrent Nan Ruyin prefect.
units.literal: In year eleven he was transferred bearer of staff, commander of Yu, north Yu, and Huo, faithful martial general and Yuzhou inspector, with concurrent Nan Ruyin prefect.

units.zh: 在州四年，卒。
units.en: After four years in the province he died.
units.literal: After four years in the province he died.

units.zh: 仙琕號泣，謂弟仲艾曰：「蒙大造之恩，未獲上報。
units.en: Xianpin wept and said to his younger brother Zhong'ai, "Having received great creating grace, I have not yet repaid it.
units.literal: Xianpin wept and said to his younger brother Zhong'ai: "Having received great creating grace, I have not yet repaid it.

units.zh: 子巖夫嗣。
units.en: His son Yanfu inherited.
units.literal: His son Yanfu inherited.

units.zh: 仙琕少以果敢聞，遭父憂，毀瘠過禮，負土成墳，手植松柏。
units.en: From youth Xianpin was known for daring; when his father died his mourning exceeded ritual—he carried earth for the mound and planted pines and cypresses himself.
units.literal: Xianpin from youth was known for daring and resolve; when his father died his grief-wasting exceeded ritual—he carried earth to make the mound and planted pines and cypresses with his own hands.

units.zh: 緬卒，事明帝。
units.en: When Mian died, he served Emperor Ming.
units.literal: When Mian died, he served Emperor Ming.

units.zh: 會壽陽新陷，魏將王肅侵邊，仙琕力戰，以寡克衆，魏人甚憚之。
units.en: When Shouchun had newly fallen, Wei general Wang Su raided the border; Xianpin fought hard, the few overcame the many, and Wei greatly feared him.
units.literal: When Shouchun had newly fallen, Wei general Wang Su invaded the border; Xianpin fought hard, with the few overcame the many, and Wei men greatly feared him.

units.zh: 義師至新林，仙琕猶持兵於江西，日鈔運漕，建康城陷，仙琕號哭經宿，乃解兵歸罪。
units.en: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, Xianpin still held arms west of the river, daily requisitioning transport grain; when Jiankang fell, he wept all night, then laid down arms and came to submit his guilt.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, Xianpin still held arms on the west of the river, daily requisitioning transport grain; when Jiankang fell, Xianpin wept and wailed a whole night, then laid down arms and came to submit his guilt.

units.zh: 仙琕謝曰：「小人如失主犬，後主飼之，便復爲用。」
units.en: Xianpin apologized, "A petty man is like a stray dog without a master; when a new master feeds it, it serves again."
units.literal: Xianpin apologized: "A petty man is like a stray dog without a master; when a new master feeds it, it will serve again."

units.zh: 今復荷殊澤，當與爾以心力自效耳。」
units.en: Now again receiving special favor—we shall repay with all our strength, you and I."
units.literal: Now again receiving special favor—we shall repay with all our strength, you and I."

units.zh: 與諸將論議，口未嘗言功。
units.en: When the generals discussed affairs, he never spoke of merit.
units.literal: When discussing with the generals, he never spoke of merit in his mouth.

units.zh: 人問其故，仙琕曰：「丈夫爲時所知，當進不求名，退不逃罪，乃平生願也。
units.en: When asked why, Xianpin said, "A man whom the age knows should advance without seeking fame and retreat without escaping punishment—that is his lifetime wish.
units.literal: When asked the reason, Xianpin said: "A man whom the age knows should advance without seeking fame and retreat without escaping punishment—that is his lifetime wish.

units.zh: 何功可論！」
units.en: What merit is there to discuss!"
units.literal: What merit is there to discuss!"

units.zh: 仙琕坐徵還，爲雲騎將軍。
units.en: Xianpin was recalled for the failure and made cloud-cavalry general.
units.literal: Xianpin sat out the blame and was recalled, made cloud-cavalry general.

units.zh: 出爲仁威司馬，府主豫章王轉號雲麾，復爲司馬，加振遠將軍。
units.en: He went out as benevolent prestige staff officer; when the manor lord Prince of Yuzhang changed title to cloud-banner, he again became staff officer with additional shaking-the-distant general.
units.literal: He went out as benevolent prestige staff officer; when the lord of the manor Prince of Yuzhang changed title to cloud-banner, he again became staff officer with additional shaking-the-distant general.

units.zh: 魏徐州刺史盧昶以衆十餘萬赴焉。
units.en: Wei Xuzhou inspector Lu Chang came with more than a hundred thousand men.
units.literal: Wei Xuzhou Inspector Lu Chang came with a host of more than a hundred thousand.

units.zh: 仙琕與戰，累破之，昶遁走。
units.en: Xianpin fought him, repeatedly defeated him, and Chang fled.
units.literal: Xianpin fought him, repeatedly defeating him; Chang fled away.

units.zh: 仙琕縱兵乘之，魏衆免者十一二，收其兵糧牛馬器械，不可勝數。
units.en: Xianpin loosed troops in pursuit; only one or two in ten of Wei's host escaped; grain, cattle, horses, and arms taken were beyond counting.
units.literal: Xianpin loosed troops to pursue; of Wei's host only one or two in ten escaped; grain, cattle, horses, and implements taken were beyond counting.

units.zh: 振旅還京師，遷太子左衛率，進爵爲侯，增邑六百戶。
units.en: The army returned in triumph; he was transferred crown prince left guard leader, advanced to marquis, fief increased by six hundred households.
units.literal: The army returned to the capital in triumph; he was transferred crown prince left guard leader, advanced in rank to marquis, fief increased by six hundred households.

units.zh: 自爲將及居州郡，能與士卒同勞逸。
units.en: As general and in commanderies and prefectures, he shared hardship and ease with officers and soldiers.
units.literal: From serving as general and holding commanderies and prefectures, he could share hardship and ease with officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 身衣不過布帛，所居無帷幕衾屏，行則飲食與廝養最下者同。
units.en: His clothing was no more than plain cloth and silk; his dwelling had no curtains, quilts, or screens; on the march he ate and drank with the lowest groom.
units.literal: His body clothing was no more than plain cloth and silk; where he dwelt there were no curtains, quilts, or screens; on the march his food and drink were the same as the lowest groom.

units.zh: 其在邊境，常單身潛入敵庭，伺知壁壘村落險要處所，故戰多克捷，士卒亦甘心爲之用，高祖雅愛仗之。
units.en: On the borders he often went alone in secret into enemy camps to learn walls, stockades, villages, and passes; hence he mostly won battles, and the soldiers were willing to die for him; Gaozu deeply loved and relied on him.
units.literal: On the borders he often went alone in secret into enemy camps to reconnoiter walls, stockades, villages, and strategic points; hence battles were mostly victorious, and the soldiers too were willing to die for him; Gaozu deeply loved and relied on him.

units.zh: 贈左衛將軍。
units.en: Granted left guard general.
units.literal: Granted left guard general.

units.zh: 高祖使仙琕赴之，又遣直閤將軍武會超、馬廣率衆爲援。
units.en: Gaozu sent Xianpin; he also sent direct-palace general Wu Huichao and Ma Guang with troops as reinforcements.
units.literal: Gaozu sent Xianpin to go; he also sent direct-palace general Wu Huichao and Ma Guang with troops as reinforcements.

units.zh: 仙琕進頓楚王城，遣副將齊苟兒以兵二千助守懸瓠。
units.en: Xianpin advanced and encamped at Prince of Chu city and sent deputy general Qi Gou'er with two thousand men to help guard Xuanhu.
units.literal: Xianpin advanced and encamped at Prince of Chu city, sent Deputy General Qi Gou'er with two thousand troops to help guard Xuanhu.

units.zh: 魏中山王元英率衆十萬攻懸瓠，仙琕遣廣、會超等守三關。
units.en: Wei's prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying led a hundred thousand men against Xuanhu; Xianpin sent Guang, Huichao, and others to guard the three passes.
units.literal: Wei's Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying led a hundred thousand host to attack Xuanhu; Xianpin sent Guang, Huichao, and others to guard the three passes.

units.zh: 仙琕不能救。
units.en: Xianpin could not rescue.
units.literal: Xianpin could not rescue.

units.zh: 其能後服，馬仙琕而已。
units.en: Only Ma Xianpin could submit afterward.
units.literal: Those who could submit later were only Ma Xianpin.

units.zh: 於是韋賢以老病免，相遂代為丞相，封高平侯，食邑八百戶。
units.en: Wei Xian was then dismissed on account of old age and illness, and Wei Xiang succeeded him as chancellor, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Gaoping with eight hundred households.
units.literal: Thereupon Wei Xian was dismissed on account of old age and illness, and Xiang then replaced him as chancellor, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Gaoping, with a fief of eight hundred households.

units.zh: 慶之欲逆戰，韋放以賊之前鋒必是輕銳，與戰若捷，不足爲功，如其不利，沮我軍勢，兵法所謂以逸待勞，不如勿擊。
units.en: Qingzhi wanted to give battle. Wei Fang objected that the enemy vanguard would be picked troops: a victory would count for little, a defeat would sap the army's spirit. Better, as the strategists say, to let the weary come to you—do not engage.
units.literal: Qingzhi wished to meet them in battle; Wei Fang argued that the enemy vanguard must be light and elite troops—if battle went well it would not be enough for merit, and if it went badly it would damp our army's momentum; as the Art of War says, wait at ease for the weary—better not to strike.

units.zh: 劉季連 陳伯之
units.en: Liu Lijian; Chen Bozhi
units.literal: Liu Lijian; Chen Bozhi

units.zh: 劉季連字惠續，彭城人也。
units.en: Liu Lijian, styled Huixu, came from Pengcheng.
units.literal: Liu Lijian, styled Huixu, was a native of Pengcheng.

units.zh: 季連有名譽，早歷清官。
units.en: Lijian was widely esteemed and early held clean posts.
units.literal: Lijian had a fine reputation and early passed through pure offices.

units.zh: 建元中，季連爲尚書左丞。
units.en: In Jianyuan he was Left Director in the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: In the Jianyuan era he was Left Director in the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 明帝心德季連，四年，以爲輔國將軍、益州刺史，令據遙欣上流。
units.en: Grateful to Lijian, in year four the emperor made him Supporting-the-State General and Yizhou inspector, set to hold the upper river against Yaoqin.
units.literal: The emperor was grateful to Lijian; in year four he made him Supporting-the-State General and inspector of Yizhou, ordering him to hold the upper reaches against Yaoqin.

units.zh: 東昏卽位，永元元年，徵季連爲右衛將軍，道斷不至。
units.en: When Eastern Depravity took the throne, in Yongyuan year one Lijian was summoned as Right Guard General; the roads were cut and he never came.
units.literal: When Eastern Depravity took the throne, in the first year of Yongyuan, Lijian was summoned as Right Guard General but the roads were cut and he did not come.

units.zh: 永明初，出爲江夏內史，累遷平南長沙內史，冠軍長史、廣陵太守，並行府州事。
units.en: At Yongming's opening he was Jiangxia interior governor, then Pingnan and Changsha, champion staff officer and Guangling prefect, all running his seat.
units.literal: At the opening of Yongming he went out as interior governor of Jiangxia, rose through interior governor of Pingnan and Changsha, champion staff officer and Guangling prefect, all while running his district seat.

units.zh: 父思考，以宋高祖族弟顯於宋世，位至金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Sikao, kin to Song Gaozu, shone in the Song age and rose to Grand Master of Splendid Virtue with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
units.literal: His father Sikao, as a cousin of Song's founding sovereign Gaozu, had been eminent in the Song age and rose to Grand Master of Splendid Virtue with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

units.zh: 季連族甥琅邪王會爲遙欣諮議參軍，美容貌，頗才辯，遙欣遇之甚厚。
units.en: Lijian's clan nephew Wang Hui of Langya was Yaoqin's advising staff officer—handsome and sharp-tongued; Yaoqin favored him.
units.literal: Lijian's clan nephew Wang Hui of Langya served as Yaoqin's advising staff officer—handsome, quick with words; Yaoqin favored him greatly.

units.zh: 明年春，遣左右陳建孫送季連弟通直郎子淵及季連二子使蜀，喻旨慰勞。
units.en: Next spring Gaozu sent close attendant Chen Jiansun to bring Lijian's younger brother Tongzhilang Ziyuan and Lijian's two sons into Shu with words of comfort.
units.literal: The next spring Gaozu sent his close attendant Chen Jiansun to convey Lijian's younger brother Tongzhilang Ziyuan and Lijian's two sons into Shu with imperial words of comfort.

units.zh: 齊高帝受禪，悉誅宋室近屬，將及季連等，太宰褚淵素善之，固請乃免。
units.en: When Qi Gaozu took the throne he meant to kill every near branch of Song; Lijian was next, but Chu Yuan, who had long favored him, pleaded until he was spared.
units.literal: When Qi Gaozu accepted the abdication, he was set to slay all near kin of the Song house; Lijian's turn was coming, but the grand minister Chu Yuan, who had long favored him, pleaded hard and he was spared.

units.zh: 建武中，又出爲平西蕭遙欣長史、南郡太守。
units.en: In Jianwu he again went out as staff officer to Pingxi general Xiao Yaoqin and Nanjun prefect.
units.literal: In the Jianwu era he again went out as staff officer to Pingxi general Xiao Yaoqin and prefect of Nanjun.

units.zh: 其年九月，季連因聚會，發人丁五千人，聲以講武，遂遣中兵參軍宋買率之以襲中水。
units.en: That September, at a gathering, he levied five thousand men under cover of drill and sent middle army staff officer Song Mai to strike Zhongshui by surprise.
units.literal: That September, under pretext of a gathering, he levied five thousand men, claiming drill, and sent middle army staff officer Song Mai to lead them in surprise at Zhongshui.

units.zh: 二年正月，高祖遣主書趙景悅宣詔降季連，季連肉袒請罪。
units.en: In year two's first month Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.
units.literal: In the first month of year two Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.

units.zh: 四年正月，因出建陽門，爲蜀人藺道恭所殺。
units.en: In year four's first month, going out the Jianyang Gate, he was killed by the Shu man Lan Daogong.
units.literal: In the first month of year four, going out the Jianyang Gate, he was killed by the Shu man Lan Daogong.

units.zh: 赦爲庶人。
units.en: He was pardoned to commoner status.
units.literal: He was pardoned to commoner status.

units.zh: 季連在蜀，殺道恭父，道恭出亡，至是而報復焉。
units.en: In Shu Lijian had killed Daogong's father; Daogong had fled and now took revenge.
units.literal: In Shu Lijian had killed Daogong's father; Daogong fled and now took revenge.

units.zh: 本以文吏知名，性忌而褊狹，至是遂嚴愎酷狠，土人始懷怨望。
units.en: Famed as a man of letters, jealous and narrow by nature, he now turned harsh, obstinate, cruel, and fierce, and the land began to resent him.
units.literal: He had been known as a man of letters; nature jealous and narrow-minded—now he turned harsh, obstinate, cruel, and fierce, and the locals first nursed resentment.

units.zh: 史臣曰：劉季連之文吏小節，而不能以自保全，習亂然也。
units.en: The historian writes: Liu Lijian had a literary man's polish, yet could not save himself—as habit in troubled times will do.
units.literal: The historian says: Liu Lijian had the small refinements of a literary official, yet could not preserve himself—such is growing accustomed to disorder.

units.zh: 季連謝曰：「早知如此，豈有前日之事。」
units.en: Lijian said, "Had I known it would come to this, there would never have been what happened before."
units.literal: Lijian said: "Had I known it would come to this, there would never have been what happened before."

units.zh: 會多所慠忽，於公座與遙欣競侮季連，季連憾之，乃密表明帝，稱遙欣有異迹。
units.en: Hui was insolent; before the assembly he and Yaoqin mocked Lijian together. Lijian nursed the grudge and secretly told the Ming Emperor that Yaoqin showed suspicious signs.
units.literal: Hui was often insolent; at a public session he vied with Yaoqin to mock Lijian, who bore a grudge and secretly reported to the Ming Emperor that Yaoqin showed suspicious conduct.

units.zh: 季連父，宋世爲益州，貪鄙無政績，州人猶以義故，善待季連。
units.en: His father had held Yizhou in Song times, greedy and without merit, yet the people, for old friendship's sake, still treated Lijian kindly.
units.literal: Lijian's father in the Song age had held Yizhou, greedy and without good governance, yet the people, still for old friendship's sake, treated Lijian kindly.

units.zh: 季連下車，存問故老，撫納新舊，見父時故吏，皆對之流涕。
units.en: On taking office he asked after elders, comforted old and new ties, and wept with his father's former clerks.
units.literal: When Lijian stepped down from his carriage he inquired of elders, comforted old and new ties, and when he saw his father's former clerks he wept openly with them.

units.zh: 季連聞東昏失德，京師多故，稍自驕矜。
units.en: Hearing Eastern Depravity's loss of virtue and the capital's many troubles, he grew proud.
units.literal: Hearing the capital racked with troubles because of Eastern Depravity's loss of virtue, he grew somewhat proud and arrogant.

units.zh: 十二月，季連遣參軍崔茂祖率衆二千討之，齎三日糧。
units.en: In the twelfth month Lijian sent staff officer Cui Maozu with two thousand to suppress them, with three days' grain.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Lijian sent staff officer Cui Maozu with two thousand to suppress them, with three days' provisions.

units.zh: 巴西太守魯休烈與涪令李膺嬰城自守，季連遣中兵參軍李奉伯率衆五千救之。
units.en: Baxi prefect Lu Xiulie and Fuling magistrate Li Ying shut the walls; Lijian sent middle army staff officer Li Fengbo with five thousand to rescue them.
units.literal: Baxi prefect Lu Xiulie and Fuling magistrate Li Ying shut the city and held firm; Lijian sent middle army staff officer Li Fengbo with five thousand to rescue them.

units.zh: 季連進討之，遣長史趙越常前驅。
units.en: Lijian advanced to punish him and sent chief clerk Zhao Yuechang ahead.
units.literal: Lijian advanced to punish him and sent his chief clerk Zhao Yuechang as vanguard.

units.zh: 兵敗，季連復遣李奉伯由涪路討之。
units.en: The army was beaten; Lijian again sent Li Fengbo by the Fuling road.
units.literal: The army was defeated; Lijian again sent Li Fengbo by the Fuling road.

units.zh: 時會稽人石文安字守休，隱居鄉里，專行禮讓，代季連爲尚書左丞，出爲江夏內史，又代季連入爲御史中丞，與季連相善。
units.en: At that time Shi Wen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion practicing courtesy, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, then replaced him again as Censor-in-Chief—and he and Lijian were friends.
units.literal: At that time Shiwen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion in his district practicing courtesy and deference, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, and again replaced Lijian as Censor-in-Chief—he and Lijian were on good terms.

units.zh: 季連受命，飭還裝。
units.en: Lijian accepted the charge and prepared to return.
units.literal: Lijian accepted the charge and prepared to return.

units.zh: 典簽朱道琛者，嘗爲季連府都錄，無賴小人，有罪，季連欲殺之，逃叛以免。
units.en: Chief controller Zhu Daochen had once been head recorder in Lijian's office—a worthless rogue with crimes; Lijian meant to kill him but he fled and lived.
units.literal: Chief controller Zhu Daochen had once been head recorder in Lijian's office—a worthless rogue with crimes; Lijian meant to kill him but he fled and lived.

units.zh: 季連亦以爲然；
units.en: Lijian believed it too;
units.literal: Lijian believed it too;

units.zh: 司馬朱士略說季連，求爲巴西郡，留三子爲質，季連許之。
units.en: Marshal Zhu Shilve urged Lijian to ask for Baxi commandery and leave three sons as hostages; Lijian agreed.
units.literal: Marshal Zhu Shilve urged Lijian to ask for Baxi commandery, leaving three sons as hostages; Lijian agreed.

units.zh: 頃之，季連遂召佐史，矯稱齊宣德皇后令，聚兵復反，收朱道琛殺之。
units.en: Before long Lijian summoned his clerks, forged an edict in the name of Qi's Virtuous-Pacifying empress dowager, gathered troops and rebelled again, seized Zhu Daochen and killed him.
units.literal: Before long Lijian summoned his clerks, forged an edict in the name of Qi's Virtuous-Pacifying empress dowager, gathered troops and rebelled again, seized Zhu Daochen and killed him.

units.zh: 季連驅略居人，閉城固守。
units.en: Lijian drove out the inhabitants, shut the city, and held firm.
units.literal: Lijian drove out the inhabitants, shut the city, and held firm.

units.zh: 是冬，季連城局參軍江希之等謀以城降，不果，季連誅之。
units.en: That winter staff officer Jiang Xizhi and others plotted to yield the city but failed; Lijian executed them.
units.literal: That winter staff officer Jiang Xizhi and others plotted to yield the city but failed; Lijian executed them.

units.zh: 季連食粥累月，饑窘無計。
units.en: Lijian ate gruel for months, hunger and straits without plan.
units.literal: Lijian ate gruel for months, hunger and straits without plan.

units.zh: 季連將發，人莫之視，惟龔愜送焉。
units.en: As Lijian was about to set out, none would look at him; only Gong Yi saw him off.
units.literal: As Lijian was about to set out, none would look at him; only Gong Yi saw him off.

units.zh: 季連旣至，詣闕謝，高祖引見之。
units.en: When Lijian arrived he went to the palace to give thanks; Gaozu received him.
units.literal: When Lijian arrived he went to the palace to give thanks; Gaozu received him.

units.zh: 季連自東掖門入，數步一稽顙，以至高祖前。
units.en: Lijian entered by the East Flank Gate, kowtowing every few steps until he stood before Gaozu.
units.literal: Lijian entered by the East Flank Gate, kowtowing every few steps until he stood before Gaozu.

units.zh: 季連復稽顙謝。
units.en: Lijian kowtowed again in thanks.
units.literal: Lijian kowtowed again in thanks.

units.zh: 服闋，刺史蕭赤斧板爲冠軍中兵參軍，領天水太守。
units.en: After mourning, Inspector Xiao Chifu made him Champion Army aide and concurrent administrator of Tianshui.
units.literal: When mourning ended, Inspector Xiao Chifu commissioned him as Champion Army Aide, concurrently Administrator of Tianshui.

units.zh: 時建元初，蠻寇羣動，景宗東西討擊，多所擒破。
units.en: Early in Jianyuan, when Man raiders rose on every side, Jingzong campaigned east and west and took many captives.
units.literal: At the time, early in Jianyuan, Man bandits were active everywhere; Jingzong campaigned east and west, capturing and defeating many.

units.zh: 按南史周捨傳有「弟子弘正」之語，是周捨乃周弘正之伯父也。
units.en: The biography of Zhou She in the History of the Southern Dynasties has the phrase "his nephew Hongzheng"; She was therefore Hongzheng's paternal uncle.
units.literal: Comment: the biography of Zhou She in the History of the Southern Dynasties has the phrase "his nephew Hongzheng"—thus Zhou She was Hongzheng's paternal uncle.

units.zh: 伯父侍中護軍捨所養 據南史改。
units.en: On "uncle Attendant-in-Ordinary and Protector-General She raised them"—emended per the History of the Southern Dynasties.
units.literal: ‘Their paternal uncle, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Protector-General She, raised them’—emended according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.

units.zh: 〔三〕 出為鄴令 錢大昕廿二史考異云：「梁之鄴縣未審所在。」
units.en: On "sent out as magistrate of Ye": Qian Daxin's Examination of Discrepancies in the Twenty-Two Histories says the site of Liang's Ye county is unknown.
units.literal: [3] Sent out as magistrate of Ye—Qian Daxin's Examination of Discrepancies in the Twenty-Two Histories says: "The location of Liang's Ye county is uncertain."

units.zh: 甲戌，以寧朔將軍柳惔為梁、南秦二州刺史。
units.en: Day jiaxu: Liu Yan, pacifying-the-north general, took Liang and South Qin.
units.literal: Day jiaxu: Pacifying-the-North General Liu Yan was made Inspector of the two provinces of Liang and South Qin.

units.zh: 嘗於殿內講《孝經》，臨川靖惠王、尚書令沈約備二傅，勉與國子祭酒張充爲執經，王瑩、張稷、柳憕、王暕爲侍講。
units.en: Once, in the palace hall, he lectured on the "Classic of Filial Piety." The King of Linchuan, King Jinghui, and Director of the Secretariat Shen Yue served as the two tutors; Mian and Libationer Zhang Chong held the text; Wang Ying, Zhang Ji, Liu Cong, and Wang Yan served as lecturing attendants.
units.literal: Once within the hall he lectured on the "Classic of Filial Piety"; the King of Linchuan, King Jinghui, and Director of the Secretariat Shen Yue served as the two tutors; Mian and Libationer of the Imperial University Zhang Chong held the classic; Wang Ying, Zhang Ji, Liu Cong, and Wang Yan served as lecturing attendants.
